cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(chimp_family VERSION 1.0 LANGUAGES CXX)
option(CHIMP_SANITIZE "ASan and UBSan" OFF)
option(CHIMP_TSAN "TSan" OFF)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
set(CMAKE_BUILD_RPATH_USE_ORIGIN TRUE)
set(CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN/../lib")
add_compile_options(-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wconversion -Wshadow -Werror -ffp-contract=off -fno-fast-math)
add_compile_options("-ffile-prefix-map=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}=." "-ffile-prefix-map=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}=.")
if(CHIMP_SANITIZE)
 add_compile_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
 add_link_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined)
endif()
if(CHIMP_TSAN)
 add_compile_options(-fsanitize=thread -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
 add_link_options(-fsanitize=thread)
endif()
add_library(chimp_family SHARED src/canonical/chimp_family.cpp)
target_include_directories(chimp_family PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>)
add_executable(chimp_cli tools/cli.cpp)
target_link_libraries(chimp_cli PRIVATE chimp_family)
add_executable(chimp_test tests/test.cpp)
target_link_libraries(chimp_test PRIVATE chimp_family pthread)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME contract COMMAND chimp_test)
install(TARGETS chimp_family chimp_cli EXPORT ChimpTargets RUNTIME DESTINATION bin LIBRARY DESTINATION lib)
install(FILES include/chimp_family.hpp DESTINATION include)
install(EXPORT ChimpTargets DESTINATION lib/cmake/chimp_family NAMESPACE Chimp::)
if(NOT CHIMP_TSAN)
 add_executable(chimp_oom tests/oom.cpp)
 target_compile_options(chimp_oom PRIVATE -Wno-mismatched-new-delete)
 target_link_libraries(chimp_oom PRIVATE chimp_family)
 add_test(NAME allocation_failure COMMAND chimp_oom)
endif()
option(CHIMP_FUZZER "Clang libFuzzer target" OFF)
if(CHIMP_FUZZER)
 add_executable(chimp_fuzz tests/fuzz.cpp src/canonical/chimp_family.cpp)
 target_include_directories(chimp_fuzz PRIVATE include)
 target_compile_options(chimp_fuzz PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer,address,undefined)
 target_link_options(chimp_fuzz PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer,address,undefined)
endif()
add_executable(chimp_bench tools/bench.cpp)
target_link_libraries(chimp_bench PRIVATE chimp_family)
